children: has approved buying 27.03% of Clean Renewable Energy KK 1E Private Limited for INR51.45mn ($552,340) , the company said in a filing to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India on November 19.

The stake will give the company a share of solar power for its Muddapur plant under a captive power arrangement. The company said the deal would raise the proportion of renewable energy in its power mix. It described the investment as part of its plan to make greater use of renewable sources. J.K. Cement will subscribe to 1,101,949 equity shares with a face value of INR10 each and will pay in cash.

The filing listed no government or regulatory approvals as necessary for the transaction. The company said the purchase was not a related party transaction. Neither its promoter, its promoter group nor its group companies hold any interest in the target, according to the filing. Clean Renewable Energy KK 1E is promoted by Hero Rooftop Energy Private Limited and was incorporated in 2024.

Its registered office is in Aerocity, near New Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport. The firm develops and runs a 125.8 MW hybrid project in the southern state of Karnataka, made up of 26.4 MW of wind capacity and solar capacity of 99.4 MWac, or 149.1 MWp. Power from the project is supplied under an open access mechanism, and the power producer's allocation stands at 11.4 MW.

The target company remains at an early stage. It booked turnover of INR400,000 in the 2025-26 financial year, after reporting no revenue in 2024-25. As of March 31, 2026, it posted a net loss of INR4mn and a negative net worth of INR5.6mn.

title: India's J.K. Cement buys 27% stake in renewable power firm
